zh.title: 芬蘭調查俄羅斯直升機疑似進入領空
zh.summary: 芬蘭國防部表示，11月21日洛維薩外海疑有一架俄羅斯直升機進入芬蘭領空，邊防衛隊已展開調查。
body: 芬蘭國防部表示，11月21日洛維薩外海疑有一架俄羅斯直升機進入芬蘭領空。AeroTime 引述芬蘭國防部報導，疑似事件發生於當地時間中午，進入領空的最大距離約4.1公里。
芬蘭邊防衛隊表示，正調查這起疑似事件。同日，俄羅斯貨輪 Sparta II 在芬蘭灣起火，船員後來獲救。邊防衛隊表示，船隻在洛維薩外海下錨，救援單位繼續處理火勢。
芬蘭方面指出，直升機事件可能與貨輪救援或監控有關。兩起事件是否有直接關聯，仍待調查釐清。

en.title: Finland investigates suspected Russian helicopter airspace entry off Loviisa
en.summary: The Finnish Defence Ministry reported a suspected incursion on November 21. The Border Guard is investigating.
body: Finland’s Defence Ministry said a Russian helicopter was suspected of entering Finnish airspace off Loviisa on November 21. AeroTime reported that the ministry placed the incident around midday and estimated the possible incursion at up to 4.1 kilometres.

The Finnish Border Guard said it was investigating. The Russian cargo vessel Sparta II caught fire in the Gulf of Finland the same day. Its crew was evacuated while emergency crews continued firefighting off Loviisa.
Finland said the helicopter incident might be related to rescue or monitoring work near the damaged ship. Any direct connection remains under investigation.

facts.claim: Finland reported a suspected Russian helicopter incursion off Loviisa.
The defence ministry estimated a possible incursion up to 4.1 kilometres.
The suspected incursion may be connected to rescue or monitoring involving Sparta II.
